snippet.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
What happens when you drop four explorers into a cursed jungle? Pure, unadulterated chaos. From moments of sheer awe to heart-pounding tension and terrified laughter, this is friendship tested by cosmic horror.

Prepare for your own expedition as The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu launches on July 15th, 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2569760/The_Mound_Omen_of_Cthulhu/
